verdict.rationale: Shopify POS documents multi-location operation: a centralized back office supporting 1,000+ locations, per-location inventory tracking that syncs in real time, and transfers between locations. It does not show per-location device management, per-location settings, or reporting broken down by location; reporting is mentioned only generically. missing for 10: per-location device assignment/management, per-location settings configuration, location-level reporting, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can run multiple locations with per-location devices, settings, and reporting

citations.quote: Scale your business with a centralized back office that supports 1,000+ locations.
Track and assign inventory at every location that syncs in real time across POS, online store, and every sales channel.
Shopify POS syncs with Shopify to track your orders and inventory across your retail locations
